Name: FinGuard
Description: AI-powered loan default risk prediction SaaS
Website: https://finguard.io

## Crawl Policy
Allow: /docs, /api/docs, /pricing, /about, /contact, /blog
Disallow: /dashboard, /results/*, /admin/*, /api/predict

## Contact
Support Email: support@finguard.io

## Model & Data Info
Model Type: LightGBM (CPU, <200ms inference, single .pkl)
Training Data: Home Credit Historical (anonymized, no PII)
Output: Default probability 0-1, credit score 300-850, risk band (Low/Medium/High)

## Rate Limits
API: 100 req/min per key
Web crawling: 1 req/sec max

## Changelog
2026-09-09: Model v2 deployed (AUC 0.786, threshold cost-tuned FP=5x FN)
2026-01-10: Added risk band calibration
